header_clock: A request counter and timestamp in the header of every prompt; the prefix dies at token 3.
history_rewrite: Conversation history is re-worded every turn (synonym drift) instead of appended verbatim.
json_churn: A JSON state blob re-serialised with shuffled keys each request, with occasional genuine value changes the auditor must not blame on ordering.
long_gap_ttl: Shuffled tool list, but requests land 6-12 minutes apart against a 5-minute cache TTL; expiry, not ordering, is the binding cost.
mixed_kitchen_sink: Volatile header, retrieved-first layout and a shuffled tool list in one session; the earliest breaker masks the others.
retrieved_first: Fresh retrieved chunks are placed before the system text and tool definitions, so their churn invalidates the static segments behind them.
stable: Control session: constant header, sorted tools, append-only history; retrieval churns after the static prefix, where churn is cheap.
tool_shuffle: The tool definitions are re-shuffled on every request; same tools, same text, new order.
